label: Southern Patagonia fixed-coordinate contrast, PATICE 25 ka BP slice

location.coordinateMeaning: WGS84 transform of UTM 18S E 550000, N 4200000, selected well inside the 25 and 20 ka ice polygons and well outside the 15 and 13 ka ice polygons.

temporal.localTimeInput: 10:00 local hour, calendar day and season unspecified
temporal.supportedResolution: Published PATICE 25 ka reconstruction slice and point-in-polygon membership.
temporal.precisionBoundary: The slice supports ice-sheet membership, not an annual surface elevation, weather event, snow state, margin position, or velocity.

habitation.evidence: The point is deep inside reconstructed ice at 25 ka BP and predates the cited Southern Cone occupation horizon.
habitation.qualification: The human chronology is regional; the decisive local condition is an ice-sheet interior point.

viewpoint.support: Patagonian Ice Sheet surface at a point approximately 73.5 kilometres from the nearest reconstructed 25 ka margin.
invalidAlternatives: lateral moraine beside a valley glacier

visibleGroundTruth.claim: The point intersects the official PATICE Icesheet25ka reconstruction polygon.
visibleGroundTruth.visualConsequence: Ice supports the optic and fills the foreground through the reconstructed interior.

visibleGroundTruth.claim: The point is approximately 73.5 kilometres from the nearest reconstructed 25 ka margin in the source projection.
visibleGroundTruth.visualConsequence: This is an interior-ice test rather than an uncertainty-prone boundary composition.

visibleGroundTruth.claim: Exact local surface relief, crevassing, snow, cloud, and wind are unresolved by the polygon.
visibleGroundTruth.visualConsequence: A coherent ice-surface event may use plausible cold-region material behavior while keeping it out of the source-backed claim.

obligations: Place the optic on ice and make interior support legible.
Compose from snow and ice surface, stress or wind geometry, atmosphere, light, and scale.
Keep local weather and microtopography in the bounded-inference register.
Use the same coordinate and declared optic geometry across PATM-20000 and PATM-15000.
oracleOnlyContradictions: The reconstructed point is not exposed land or water at the 25 ka slice.
The nearest reconstructed margin is too distant for a boundary-straddling foreground.
Human figures and Holocene infrastructure are unsupported.
The shapefile name and confidence metadata are evaluator evidence rather than visible scenery.

sources.title: The evolution of the Patagonian Ice Sheet from 35 ka to the present day
The arrival of Homo sapiens into the Southern Cone at 14,000 years ago

uncertainty: Exact 25 ka ice-surface elevation, slope, snow state, crevassing, weather, and season.
The reconstruction margin confidence is segment-specific; no confidence class is inferred for this interior point.
Calendar conversion uses BP relative to 1950 and is approximate at this visual scale.

review.notes: Point-in-polygon and nearest-margin calculations were recorded from the official PATICE version-2 reconstruction shapefiles.
